title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Braelon Allen (ankle) good to go for Sunday
items.desc: Braelon Allen (ankle) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Las Vegas Raiders.
items.impact: Allen will be available to play on Sunday, despite being listed on the injury report earlier in the week due to an ankle injury. He should be a full go in Week 8 and will be New York's primary running back if Breece Hall (quad) is unable to suit up against the Raiders.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dylan Parham (knee) considered questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Dylan Parham (knee) is considered questionable for Sunday's game against the Las Vegas Raiders.
items.impact: Parham is uncertain to play on Sunday. He's still dealing with a knee issue of some kind right now, and it may leave him sidelined against the Raiders. That will be bad news for New York's offensive front if that's the case.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: LeQuint Allen Jr. (hamstring) set to play Sunday
items.desc: LeQuint Allen Jr. (hamstring) is set to play in Sunday's game against the Indianapolis Colts.
items.impact: Allen is set to play in Week 8. He was limited at practice earlier in the week due to a hamstring issue, but it's not a serious issue and won't prevent him from playing in Week 8. He isn't likely to be heavily involved moving forward, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Brenton Strange (eye) cleared to play Sunday
items.desc: Brenton Strange (eye) has been cleared to play in Sunday's game against the Indianapolis Colts.
items.impact: Strange has been listed on the injury report throughout the week due to a minor eye issue, but it won't stop him from playing in a full capacity in Week 8. He may see more work than usual if Jakobi Meyers (hamstring/ankle) is ruled out against the Colts.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jakobi Meyers (hamstring/ankle) questionable to play Sunday
items.desc: Jakobi Meyers (hamstring/ankle) is questionable to play in Sunday's game against the Indianapolis Colts.
items.impact: Meyers was downgraded to a non-participant at practice on Friday. He's now dealing with an ankle issue in addition to his nagging hamstring injury, and he is officially considered questionable to play. Brian Thomas Jr. and Brenton Strange may see more work if the veteran is unable to play against Indianapolis.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Lamar Jackson (ankle) officially off injury report for Sunday
items.desc: Lamar Jackson (ankle) is officially off of Baltimore's injury report ahead of Sunday's game against the Buffalo Bills.
items.impact: It was already reported that Jackson is set to make his return to the lineup on Sunday, but he is now off of the injury report entirely and will be a full go for Week 8. Fantasy managers shouldn't hesitate to start him in this matchup, though they shouldn't be surprised if he isn't as active as a rusher in his first game back.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: John Simpson (groin) good to go for Sunday
items.desc: John Simpson (groin) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Buffalo Bills.
items.impact: Simpson is officially good to go for Sunday's game, which has been expected all week despite his nagging groin issue. Baltimore's offensive line should be at nearly full strength for this matchup.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ed Oliver (knee) will play Sunday
items.desc: Ed Oliver (knee) will play in Sunday's game against the Baltimore Ravens.
items.impact: Buffalo's standout defensive tackle will be available to play on Sunday, despite being limited at practice earlier in the week with a knee issue. The team will need him to step up and play well if they want to contain a strong Baltimore offense on Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ray Davis (illness) cleared to play Sunday
items.desc: Ray Davis (illness) has been cleared to play in Sunday's game against the Baltimore Ravens.
items.impact: Davis missed Thursday's practice due to an illness of some kind, but he made his return on Friday and is not listed on the team's injury report heading into the weekend. He will be good to go for Sunday's game and will continue to play a depth role in this backfield behind James Cook III moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ben Skowronek (calf) listed questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Ben Skowronek (calf) is listed questionable for Sunday's game against the Cleveland Browns.
items.impact: The veteran wideout will have a chance to play on Sunday. His calf injury has left him sidelined for a little while, but he seems to be close to full health at this point. He won't be fantasy relevant moving forward, however, even if he's cleared to make his return to the lineup on Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jared Verse (knee) off injury report for Sunday
items.desc: Jared Verse (knee) is off of the injury report ahead of Sunday's game against the Pittsburgh Steelers.
items.impact: Verse is off of the injury report heading into the weekend, meaning that he will be a full go against the Steelers. His presence is great news for Cleveland's defensive front ahead of this divisional matchup.

items.desc: Dylan Sampson (knee) is set to play in Sunday's game against the Pittsburgh Steelers.
items.impact: Sampson is set to play on Sunday, despite being listed on Cleveland's injury report earlier in the week with a knee issue. He isn't expected to see enough work to be fantasy relevant in this matchup, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Elgton Jenkins (knee) cleared to play Sunday
items.desc: Elgton Jenkins (knee) has been cleared to play in Sunday's game against the Pittsburgh Steelers.
items.impact: Jenkins missed practice early in the week due to a knee issue, but he has received full clearance and will play for the Browns on Sunday. His presence will help Cleveland's offensive front substantially in a tough matchup against the Steelers this week.
